EXT_color_buffer_float.note: MDN first versions: Chrome 56, Safari 15, Firefox 51, Edge 79. MDN page says WebGL2 contexts only. web3dsurvey desktop shares: Windows 99.99%, macOS 99.99%, Linux 99.66%.

EXT_color_buffer_half_float.note: MDN first versions: Chrome 63, Safari 14, Firefox 47, Edge 17. MDN page says WebGL1 and WebGL2 contexts. web3dsurvey desktop shares: Windows 92%, macOS 92.68%, Linux 60.97%. Desktop shares differ by 30 points or more between platforms, so it depends on platform or hardware. MDN lists support, yet web3dsurvey shows under half of WebGL2 reports expose it in: Firefox 2.96% (all platforms).

OES_texture_float_linear.note: MDN first versions: Chrome 29, Safari 8, Firefox 24, Edge 12. MDN page says WebGL1 and WebGL2 contexts. web3dsurvey desktop shares: Windows 99.99%, macOS 88.99%, Linux 97.51%.

OES_texture_half_float_linear.note: MDN first versions: Chrome 29, Safari 8, Firefox 30, Edge 14. MDN page says WebGL1 contexts only, and that in WebGL2 the feature is built in and the extension is not needed, so the browser values describe the WebGL1 extension. No web3dsurvey WebGL2 page for this name, so the desktop share could not be read and is null.
